label: The Wrong Reservation
summary: Two people, one rooftop table, the same name on the booking. Neither of you is leaving.
title: The Wrong Reservation
description: The best table on the city's best rooftop is booked under your name. It is also booked under someone else's, and they are already sitting at it.

chapterOutlines.title: Table for Two
chapterOutlines.outline: Share the table, trade barbs, and find out why they needed this night as much as you did.

chapterOutlines.title: Second Chances
chapterOutlines.outline: Run into each other again, on purpose or not.

chapterOutlines.title: The Last Train
chapterOutlines.outline: The 1:10 leaves in ten minutes. Say it or don't.

scene.location: The rooftop terrace of the Larkspur, above the river
scene.summary: Friday night, string lights and a warm wind off the water. A stranger is sitting at your table, reading your name on the reservation card.

openThreads: Why did they need this table tonight?

npcs.name: Rowan Hale
npcs.description: Owns a bakery by the third bridge, has flour on one cuff, and was supposed to be celebrating something tonight.
goals: Prove tonight can still go right
